test_merge_ordered_basic: test merge_ordered merges two DataFrames on a shared key column with forward-fill
test_merge_ordered_ffill: test merge_ordered with fill_method='ffill' propagates values across merged rows
test_merge_ordered_multigroup: test merge_ordered groups left and right DataFrames by a grouping column before merging
test_merge_ordered_left_by_right_by: test merge_ordered supports both left_by and right_by grouping parameters
test_merge_ordered_invalid_fill_method: test merge_ordered raises ValueError when fill_method is neither 'ffill' nor None
